plugins.name: appwrite
plugins.description: Appwrite tools for Claude Code, including SDK skills, the hosted Appwrite MCP server, and deployment commands.

skills.name: cli
skills.description: Appwrite CLI skill. Use when managing Appwrite projects from the command line. Covers installation, login, project initialization, multi-file project configuration, deploying functions/sites/tables/buckets/teams/webhooks/topics, flag-based list queries, non-interactive CI/CD mode, and generating type-safe SDKs.
headings: Switch to a different saved account
Pull or push individual resource groups
skills.description_zh: 通过 Appwrite CLI 管理项目，涵盖安装登录、初始化、多文件配置、函数/站点/表/存储桶/团队/webhook/topic 部署、参数式列表查询、非交互 CI/CD 和类型安全 SDK 生成。

skills.name: dart
skills.description: Appwrite Dart SDK skill. Use when building Flutter apps (mobile, web, desktop) or server-side Dart applications with Appwrite. Covers client-side auth (email, OAuth), database queries, file uploads with native file handling, real-time subscriptions, and server-side admin via API keys for user management, database administration, storage, and functions.
skills.description_zh: 用 Appwrite Dart SDK 构建 Flutter 移动、Web、桌面或服务端 Dart：邮件/OAuth 认证、数据库查询、原生文件上传、实时订阅，以及 API 密钥下用户、数据库、存储和函数管理。

skills.name: dotnet
skills.description: Appwrite .NET SDK skill. Use when building server-side C# or .NET applications with Appwrite, including ASP.NET and Blazor integrations. Covers user management, database/table CRUD, file storage, and functions via API keys.
skills.description_zh: 用 Appwrite .NET SDK 构建服务端 C#/.NET（含 ASP.NET 和 Blazor），通过 API 密钥进行用户管理、数据库表 CRUD、文件存储和函数操作。

skills.name: go
skills.description: Appwrite Go SDK skill. Use when building server-side Go applications with Appwrite. Covers user management, database/table CRUD, file storage, and functions via API keys. Uses per-service packages and functional options pattern.
skills.description_zh: 用 Appwrite Go SDK 构建服务端应用，通过 API 密钥进行用户管理、数据库表 CRUD、文件存储和函数操作，采用分服务包及函数选项模式。

skills.name: kotlin
skills.description: Appwrite Kotlin SDK skill. Use when building native Android apps or server-side Kotlin/JVM backends with Appwrite. Covers client-side auth (email, OAuth with Activity integration), database queries, file uploads, real-time subscriptions with coroutine support, and server-side admin via API keys for user management, database administration, storage, and functions.
skills.description_zh: 用 Appwrite Kotlin SDK 构建 Android 或 Kotlin/JVM 服务端，支持邮件/OAuth 与 Activity 集成、数据库查询、文件上传、协程实时订阅，以及 API 密钥下用户、数据库、存储和函数管理。

skills.name: php
skills.description: Appwrite PHP SDK skill. Use when building server-side PHP applications with Appwrite, including Laravel and Symfony integrations. Covers user management, database/table CRUD, file storage, and functions via API keys.
skills.description_zh: 用 Appwrite PHP SDK 构建服务端应用及 Laravel/Symfony 集成，通过 API 密钥进行用户管理、数据库表 CRUD、文件存储和函数操作。

skills.name: python
skills.description: Appwrite Python SDK skill. Use when building server-side Python applications with Appwrite, including Django, Flask, and FastAPI integrations. Covers user management, database/table CRUD, file storage, and functions via API keys.
headings: Create table with explicit string column types
skills.description_zh: 用 Appwrite Python SDK 构建服务端应用及 Django/Flask/FastAPI 集成，通过 API 密钥进行用户管理、数据库表 CRUD、文件存储和函数操作。

skills.name: ruby
skills.description: Appwrite Ruby SDK skill. Use when building server-side Ruby applications with Appwrite, including Rails and Sinatra integrations. Covers user management, database/table CRUD, file storage, and functions via API keys.
headings: Create table with explicit string column types
skills.description_zh: 用 Appwrite Ruby SDK 构建服务端应用及 Rails/Sinatra 集成，通过 API 密钥进行用户管理、数据库表 CRUD、文件存储和函数操作。

skills.name: rust
skills.description: Appwrite Rust SDK skill. Use when building server-side Rust applications with Appwrite. Covers async client setup with API keys, user management, TablesDB database/table/row operations, file storage, function executions, permissions, queries, and error handling. Uses the crates.io `appwrite` package and Tokio.
skills.description_zh: 用 crates.io appwrite 包和 Tokio 构建服务端 Rust，支持 API 密钥异步客户端、用户管理、TablesDB 数据库表行、存储、函数执行、权限查询和错误处理。

skills.name: swift
skills.description: Appwrite Swift SDK skill. Use when building native iOS, macOS, watchOS, or tvOS apps, or server-side Swift applications with Appwrite. Covers client-side auth (email, OAuth), database queries, file uploads, real-time subscriptions with async/await, and server-side admin via API keys for user management, database administration, storage, and functions.
skills.description_zh: 用 Appwrite Swift SDK 构建 iOS、macOS、watchOS、tvOS 或服务端应用，支持邮件/OAuth、数据库查询、文件上传、async/await 实时订阅，以及 API 密钥下用户、数据库、存储和函数管理。

skills.name: typescript
skills.description: Appwrite TypeScript SDK skill. Use when building browser-based JavaScript/TypeScript apps, React Native mobile apps, or server-side Node.js/Deno backends with Appwrite. Covers client-side auth (email, OAuth, anonymous), database queries, file uploads, real-time subscriptions, and server-side admin via API keys for user management, database administration, storage, and functions.
skills.description_zh: 用 Appwrite TypeScript SDK 构建浏览器 JS/TS、React Native 或 Node.js/Deno 后端，支持邮件/OAuth/匿名认证、数据库查询、文件上传、实时订阅及 API 密钥下服务端用户数据库存储函数管理。
